sentence: Adding manpower to a late software project makes it later.

source.author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
source.work: The Mythical Man-Month: Essays on Software Engineering
source.detail: 第二章 The Mythical Man-Month，即著名的“布鲁克斯定律”（Brooks's Law）

translation: 给一个已经延期的软件项目加人，只会让它延期得更厉害。
grammar: 主干是“主语 + makes + 宾语 + 宾补”：主语是动名词短语 Adding manpower to a late software project，谓语 makes，宾语 it（指 the project），宾补 later。动名词短语作主语时视为单数，所以谓语用 makes 而不是 make。
make + 宾语 + 形容词（比较级）表示“使……变得更……”：makes it later = 让它更晚。用比较级 later 呼应前面的 late，形成“晚→更晚”的对照，这正是这句话又短又有讽刺力的原因，类似 make things worse、make it easier。

vocab.collocation: add manpower; a shortage of manpower; manpower costs
vocab.example: The factory is facing a shortage of manpower this winter.

vocab.collocation: be late for sth; run late; a late delivery
vocab.example: The firmware release is two weeks late.

vocab.collocation: add features to a product; add value to sth
vocab.example: Don't add new features to the build the night before release.

vocab.collocation: launch a project; a project deadline; be behind on a project
vocab.example: Our MCU project is behind schedule because of a hardware bug.

note: Brooks 的理由是：新人要培训、沟通成本随人数快速增长，任务也不一定能拆分。小练习：用 make + 宾语 + 比较级 造个句，比如 “Rushing the code review makes the bugs harder to find.” 试着写一句你自己工作里的。
